report.title: TEN at DAL Week 11 Scouting Report
report.summary: DAL's offense is built on a passing game that gets more dangerous on third down and in the red zone, while its run defense is its real strength. TEN's best route is to pressure the pass defense on long downs, attack the secondary, and handle a heavy box on the ground. Special teams favor Dallas, and the availability of Bland and Spears could shape late-game decisions.

Efficiency lives in the passing game at 0.15 EPA per pass play [oc8] over 422 [oc9] plays, against 0.01 per run play [oc10]. Play action shows on 21.8% of dropbacks [oc14] and pre-snap motion on 46.6% of plays [oc17]. Volume concentrates on C.Lamb at 32.1% of targets [oc18] and G.Pickens at 21.2% [oc19]. J.Williams is the primary back, running up the middle on 39.5% of designed runs [oc20]. TEN's defense allows 0.20 EPA per pass play [oc21] and explosive passes on 10.6% [oc22], so the matchup favors DAL's passing game. DAL scores on 70.0% of red-zone drives [oc24], 4th in the league [oc25]. TEN allows touchdowns on 65.7% of red-zone drives [oc28].

sections.heading: Opponent defense
sections.body: DAL's run defense is its strength, allowing 0.01 EPA per run play [dc1] over 263 [dc2] runs with 6.6 defenders in the box [dc3], so expect a loaded box on most carries. The pass defense is the weak spot at 0.20 EPA per dropback allowed [dc4]. DAL ranks 32nd [dc9] on third down, allowing conversions on 49.6% [dc10] over 127 [dc11] plays, and it allows touchdowns on 68.4% [dc12] of red-zone drives over 38 [dc13] drives. DAL blitzes on 23.0% of dropbacks [dc15] over 366 [dc16], averaging 4.2 pass rushers [dc17]. TEN's offense has allowed a 12.5% pressure proxy [dc20] and a 4.4% sack rate [dc21], so its protection has held up reasonably well.

sections.heading: Special teams
sections.body: Dallas has one kicker all season, B.Aubrey, who has made 19 [kc1] of 24 [kc2] field goals, a 79.2% [kc3] make rate. His range is the weakness at 50.0% [kc4] on 10 [kc5] long-range tries, so treat long Dallas field goals as close to a coin flip. Dallas punts net 42.4 [kc6] yards, with 53.8% [kc8] landing deep inside TEN's territory, so expect TEN to start many possessions deep. Kickoffs are touchbacks only 14.5% [kc9] of the time on 62 [kc10] attempts. The Dallas return unit averages 26.2 [kc13] yards on 44 [kc14] returns, so consider kicking away from that returner late in close games. Overall Dallas special-teams EPA is 0.01 [kc15] per play, ranked 14th [kc17] in the league, against -0.04 [kc18] per play for TEN, so the edge sits with Dallas.

sections.heading: Injuries and availability
sections.body: DAL TE Jake Ferguson is Out this week [ic1]. He has taken 7.2% of team targets [ic2] over 377 [ic3], so that volume shifts to receivers and backs. CB DaRon Bland is Questionable with an 89.3% [ic5] mean snap share across 10 [ic6] games. CB Joey Porter Jr. is also Questionable, with a 60.4% [ic8] snap share over 5 [ic9] games, so expect DAL's coverage depth to be tested if either sits. TEN RB Tyjae Spears is Questionable with a 39.3% [ic11] snap share over 7 [ic12] games and carries 11.9% [ic13] of team rushes. TEN WR Carnell Tate is Out [ic14]. DAL LB Donovan Ezeiruaku is Out [ic15], which thins the box on DAL's side.

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: Third down decides first. DAL converts 45.1% [mc1] of third downs, 5th in the league [mc2], against TEN's 44.7% [mc3] allowed. DAL throws on 81.0% [mc4] of third-and-long over 42 [mc5] plays, so expect Lamb and Pickens there and play deep-safety coverage against TEN's 0.20 EPA per dropback allowed [mc6] and explosive passes on 10.6% [mc7]. Second, the run faces a heavy box: DAL's run defense allows 0.01 EPA per run [mc10] over 263 [mc11] runs with 6.6 defenders in the box [mc12]. Spears is Questionable [mc13] and carries 11.9% [mc14] of TEN's rushes, so use play action off the same run looks rather than committing to the ground game. Third, pressure: DAL blitzes on 23.0% [mc15] of dropbacks, so use quick throws, hot reads and screens against 4.2 pass rushers [mc17]. Fourth, the secondary: Ferguson is Out [mc21], and if Bland sits, attack the outside.
